title: Slovakian Fluffy Pancakes
description: Fluffy Slovakian-style pancakes with a hint of sweetness, perfect for a weekend breakfast. Serve warm with your favorite toppings.

ingredients.name: juicy egg
ingredients.notes: Large eggs for light and fluffy pancakes

ingredients.name: fluffy flour
ingredients.notes: All-purpose flour for a classic pancake texture

ingredients.name: slovakian sugar
ingredients.notes: Add a touch of sweetness to balance the flavors

ingredients.name: bake baking powder
ingredients.notes: Leavening agent for a light and airy texture

ingredients.name: bake milk
ingredients.notes: Whole milk for added richness and moisture

instructions: 1. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, and baking powder.
2. In a separate bowl, whisk together egg, milk, and a pinch of salt.
3. Add the wet ingredients to the dry ingredients and stir until just combined. Do not overmix.
4. Heat a non-stick skillet or griddle over medium heat.
5. Using a 1/4 cup measuring cup, scoop the batter onto the skillet or griddle.
6. Cook for 2-3 minutes, until bubbles appear on the surface and the edges start to dry.
7. Flip the pancakes and cook for an additional 1-2 minutes, until golden brown.
8. Serve warm with your favorite toppings, such as maple syrup, fresh fruit, or whipped cream.
